name: juno-health-tools
description: Privacy-conscious workflows for symptom language, health timelines, flare reflection, and appointment preparation.

interface.longDescription: Juno Health Tools helps people organise non-identifying, user-authored symptom descriptions, timelines, flare reflections, and appointment questions. It processes submitted text transiently after explicit consent, does not intentionally retain tool inputs or outputs, and does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn messy health notes into a concise appointment brief.
Help me find neutral words to describe this symptom clearly.
Organise these dated observations into a factual health timeline.
